title: Lack of Network Segmentation
description: The network is flat or insufficiently segmented, allowing broad lateral communication between workstations, servers, and sensitive systems. Once an attacker gains a foothold on any host, the absence of internal boundaries lets them move laterally and reach critical assets with little resistance.
businessImpact: High --- poor segmentation greatly increases breach blast radius, accelerating lateral movement, ransomware propagation, and access to crown-jewel systems.
remediation:
- Segment the network into security zones (user, server, management, OT, DMZ) with enforced boundaries.
- Restrict east-west traffic with firewalls/ACLs and default-deny rules between zones.
- Isolate Tier 0 / critical assets and management interfaces on dedicated segments.
- Adopt least-privilege network access and monitor inter-zone traffic.
